items.html: This is the order of his Hitpashtut in them: The Rosh of Adam ha Rishon was in Olam Beria, which is now the place of ZA de Atzilut and his Garon was in the first four of Yetzira, which is now the place of Nukva de Atzilut. You already know that Nukva de Atzilut is called Gan Eden, thus only his Garon was placed in Gan Eden.
